install.subtitle: The cabin book as an app on your phone
install.benefitHome: Opens straight from your home screen, like a normal app
install.benefitOffline: Works at the cabin without signal
install.benefitSync: Changes are sent automatically when you are back online
install.iosStep1: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari
install.iosStep2: Scroll down and choose “Add to Home Screen”
install.iosNote: Apple doesn't let websites install themselves, so it has to go through the Share menu.
install.otherText: Open this page in Chrome on Android or Safari on iPhone. On a computer, look for the install icon in the address bar.
install.openFromHome: Open Hyttebok from your home screen or app list.
